display_description: Finds the right Firefox settings or preferences page for what you're looking for.

function.description: Find relevant Firefox preferences pages based on a user query. Use this when the user asks where to find a setting, how to configure something in Firefox, or where to manage Smart Window features like memories.
function.name: get_navigation_info

query.description: A natural-language description of what the user is looking for, e.g. 'where to manage memories' or 'privacy settings'.
